items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well on behalf of Hamilton I’d like to thank you for your time today

ctx.x: I had something very interesting that I brought for you to see. Stanley thinks that you will want to see it, so after I’ll show it to you.
Well on behalf of Hamilton I’d like to thank you for your time today, and it’s been a pleasure all the way around.
It was a pleasure. It’s always a nice world to talk about you know.
